CleanStatue.start_zh: 一路跋涉到了卓拉领地，却发现这里遭受到淤泥的灾害，居民们正手忙脚乱地应对。卓拉族人似乎尤为看重领地中央的石像，由于上面被
CleanStatue.start_en: Speak to Lady Yona in the center of Zora's Domain near the sludge-covered statue.
CleanStatue.note_en: Clear the sludge covering the statue in Zora's Domain by throwing a Splash Fruit or Chuchu Jelly, shooting an arrow fused with water-producing materials, or using an active Zonai Hydrant. Once clean, speak with Lady Yona again to complete the quest.

ClueTotheSixthSage.start_zh: 在远古的封印战争中，与国王劳鲁并肩抵抗魔王的是塞尔达公主和五位贤者。据普尔亚所说，要想寻找第五位贤者，就必须
ClueTotheSixthSage.start_en: Speak to Purah at Lookout Landing after completing Crisis at Hyrule Castle.
ClueTotheSixthSage.note_en: Investigate the floating Ring Ruin in Kakariko Village to trigger 'Secret of the Ring Ruins'. Head to the Faron region, solve the thunderstorm puzzle at Dracozu Lake, and journey into the storm clouds above Thunderhead Isles and Dragonhead Island to reach the Construct Factory in the Depths.

DeepHoleSurvey2.name_zh: 沉睡于地底神殿的谜团
DeepHoleSurvey2.start_zh: 乔舒亚称自己有了新的发现，正为此寻找前往地底调查的同伴。她表示“你来的正是时候”，并任命你为她的搭档。跟上乔舒亚，问清调查内容吧。
DeepHoleSurvey2.start_en: Speak to Josha at Lookout Landing after completing Camera Work in the Depths and completing at least one temple in Regional Phenomena.
DeepHoleSurvey2.note_en: Dive into the Great Plateau North Chasm (or follow the direction of the humanoid statues southwest from Iayusus Lightroot) to reach the Great Abandoned Central Mine. Activate the research terminal to acquire the Autobuild ability, then defeat Master Kohga in a vehicular boss battle. Return to Lookout Landing and demonstrate Autobuild to Josha.

DefeatGanondorf.start_zh: 风、火、水、雷、魂，五位贤者已经觉醒，并将力量托付于你。目前还不知道魔王加侬多夫的所在地。按普尔亚的说法，地底较为可疑。如果找负责调查地底的乔舒亚合作，或许会得到些线索。
DefeatGanondorf.start_en: Speak to Purah at Lookout Landing after awakening the Sages and locating the Demon King's lair in the Depths.
DefeatGanondorf.note_en: Dive deep into the chasm directly beneath Hyrule Castle into the Depths. Traverse the Gloom Trench and Forgotten Foundation past deadly enemies. Defeat the waves of the Demon King's Army, then confront Demon King Ganondorf in a three-stage climactic duel, concluding with the aerial battle against the Demon Dragon. Prepare high-defense armor and plenty of Sunny dishes that heal gloom-cracked hearts.

DividedSlate.start_zh: 与学者基奥托交谈后得知，他发现了一座古老的石碑，上面似乎有着关于天空的描述。然而
DividedSlate.start_en: Speak to the Zora historian Jiahto inside the cave at Toto Lake, north of Zora's Domain.
DividedSlate.note_en: Find the missing stone slab fragment partially buried in sludge near the entrance of the cave. Wash away the sludge using Splash Fruit or water, then use Ultrahand to lift the slab inside and rotate it to slot perfectly into the broken wall carving.

GOToTheCastleOfHyrule.start_zh: 大师之剑消失在了时之神殿的神秘光芒中，当白龙飞向天空，划破云海时，听到了塞尔达公主的声音：“来寻找我吧……”回到地面，寻找她的下落吧。是时候鼓起勇气，从苏醒的岛屿一跃而下了。
GOToTheCastleOfHyrule.start_en: Triggers automatically after sending the Master Sword through time at the Temple of Time on the Great Sky Island.
GOToTheCastleOfHyrule.note_en: Dive off the diving platform behind the Temple of Time and skydive through the cloud barrier down to the Surface. Land safely in a body of water or deep pool near Lookout Landing, then speak to Purah to report Princess Zelda's disappearance.

GetCamera.start_zh: 在地底发现了一块碎片，乔舒亚非常关注上面的
GetCamera.start_en: Speak to Robbie and Josha at Lookout Landing after activating the Lookout Landing Skyview Tower.
GetCamera.note_en: Head south from Lookout Landing to the Hyrule Field Chasm and dive into the Depths. Follow the trail of campfires west from Nisoij Lightroot toward Iayusus Lightroot to find Robbie. Talk to him to unlock the Camera and Hyrule Compendium on your Purah Pad, take a photo of the humanoid statue, and report back to Josha.

GetMasterSword.start_zh: 驱魔之剑“大师之剑”从初始空岛的时之神殿消失了。
GetMasterSword.start_en: Speak to the Great Deku Tree in Korok Forest after cleansing the Deku Tree Chasm, or collect all 11 Dragon's Tears.
GetMasterSword.note_en: Track the Light Dragon soaring through the skies of Hyrule (the Great Deku Tree marks its real-time location on your map). Launch from a nearby Skyview Tower, glide onto the Light Dragon's head, and pull the Master Sword embedded between its horns. You must have at least two full wheels of stamina (5 stamina upgrades) to successfully draw the blade.

GotoFironeZonauRemains.start_zh: 通过解读环卡遗迹的石板上所刻的左纳乌文字，塔乌洛等人认为海拉鲁东南方的亚热带费罗尼地区的左纳乌遗迹群中有某种东西。为了进行调查，他们前往了
GotoFironeZonauRemains.start_en: Speak to Paya and Tauro near the Ring Ruins in Kakariko Village after completing Crisis at Hyrule Castle.
GotoFironeZonauRemains.note_en: Use Ascend to enter the floating Ring Ruin and photograph the stone carving with your Camera. Show the photo to Tauro, then meet him at Popla Foothills / Dracozu Lake in Faron. Collect the three pieces of the Charged Armor set from snake-headed stone chests along the river, equip the full set, and place a Zonai Charge on the altar at the end of the tail to disperse the storm clouds over Thunderhead Isles.

GroundPaintingAir01.start_zh: 向博嘉多传达了塞尔达公主行踪的情况后，他建议你去找英帕打听一下消息。英帕现在正位于新玛丽塔驿站前的遗迹。英帕是否拥有
GroundPaintingAir01.start_en: Speak to Bogado or Cado, or find Impa at the roadside ruins near New Serenne Stable in North Hyrule Plain.
GroundPaintingAir01.note_en: Use Ultrahand to reattach the hot-air balloon basket to the envelope for Impa. Ignite the campfire inside the balloon with a torch or Fire Fruit to ascend. Look down from the balloon to locate the solid tear shape within the geoglyph outline. Paraglide down to the puddle and inspect it to view the Dragon's Tear memory.

HyruleCastleIncident.start_zh: 出现在海拉鲁城堡的塞尔达公主化作一道光消失了。作为搜寻塞尔达公主的下一步，普尔亚提议对各地发生的天地异变进行调查。首先需要在普尔亚平板上
HyruleCastleIncident.start_en: Speak to Purah at Lookout Landing upon arriving at the Surface, then find Captain Hoz at the First Gatehouse of Hyrule Castle.
HyruleCastleIncident.note_en: Report back to Purah to receive the Paraglider and activate the first Skyview Tower. After completing all four regional phenomena temples, return to Hyrule Castle to pursue sightings of Princess Zelda through the Second Gatehouse, Library, and Princess Zelda's Room, culminating in an intense battle against Phantom Ganon in the Sanctum.

LookingForLightSpot.start_zh: 调查时之神殿的门时，右臂之主
LookingForLightSpot.start_en: Attempt to open the front doors of the Temple of Time on the Great Sky Island and speak to Rauru.
LookingForLightSpot.note_en: Visit and complete the first three shrines on the Great Sky Island to regain your arm's abilities: Ukouh Shrine (Ultrahand), In-isa Shrine (Fuse), and Gutanbac Shrine (Ascend). Return to unlock the Temple of Time doors, interact with the glowing tear to learn Recall, and complete Nachoyah Shrine to gain the final Light of Blessing needed to pray at the Goddess Statue and push open the heavy inner doors.

MainChallenge.start_zh: 睁眼醒来，发现自己身处一座浮在空中的神奇岛屿。管家魔像把
MainChallenge.start_en: Triggers automatically at the start of the adventure after waking in the Room of Awakening and receiving the Purah Pad from the Steward Construct.
MainChallenge.note_en: Follow Princess Zelda's trail across the Great Sky Island, explore the four regional phenomena anomalies, uncover the memories of the Dragon's Tears, and awaken the Sages of ancient Hyrule to uncover the truth of Zelda's sacrifice and confront the Demon King.

MasterSwordClues.start_zh: 就连古代贤者也无法对付的魔王，驱魔之剑“大师之剑”却能令其负伤。据米涅鲁所言，塞尔达公主说过，要寻求大师之剑时，就去德库树那边。看来
MasterSwordClues.start_en: Speak to Mineru's spirit after completing Guidance from Ages Past and defeating the Seized Construct.
MasterSwordClues.note_en: Head to Minshi Woods Chasm northeast of Lookout Landing and dive into the Depths (since surface mist repels Link). Navigate through the Depths to the Rikonasum Lightroot underneath Korok Forest, then use Ascend to emerge into the heart of the forest. Dive into the Deku Tree Chasm, eliminate Gloom Hands and Phantom Ganon to purify the Great Deku Tree, and speak with him to receive the location of the Master Sword.

MemoryOfTheDragon.start_zh: 在地上图画见到了被称为龙之泪的神奇泉水，甚至其中还出现了
MemoryOfTheDragon.start_en: Examine the first Dragon's Tear at the North Hyrule Plain Geoglyph alongside Impa, or find the Forgotten Temple in Tanagar Canyon.
MemoryOfTheDragon.note_en: Explore the deepest chamber of the Forgotten Temple behind Mayausiy Shrine to uncover the ancient floor map displaying all 11 Geoglyph locations. Locate each geoglyph across Hyrule and examine the solid teardrop shape to unlock its cutscene memory. After collecting all 11 memories, head to the Rist Peninsula in East Akkala to view the 12th and final Dragon's Tear.

RepairArmor.start_zh: 卓拉铠甲曾在战斗中受损，一直寄放在卓拉领地，而优娜正在帮忙修复。有了卓拉铠甲，想必就能攀瀑了。要完成铠甲的修复工作，似乎需要用到
RepairArmor.start_en: Speak to Lady Yona in Zora's Domain (in the infirmary under the throne room) after completing The Sludge-Covered Statue.
RepairArmor.note_en: Catch an Ancient Arowana and bring it to Lady Yona. Ancient Arowanas can be found swimming in the pools around Mipha Court on Ploymus Mountain or in ponds on the Great Sky Island. Handing the fish over repairs the Zora Armor, allowing Link to swim up waterfalls.

SageOfFire.start_zh: 鼓隆城挤满了无节制地食用可口岩的鼓隆族。这片景象中不仅有阿沅的身影，事情似乎还与一名
SageOfFire.start_en: Speak to the Goron elders and Yunobo in the center of Goron City in Eldin.
SageOfFire.note_en: Follow Yunobo to the YunoboCo HQ and defeat him in combat to shatter his masked mind control. Ascend Death Mountain together, defeat the volcanic beast Moragia using a flying Zonai Wing craft, and dive into the Death Mountain Crater into the Depths. Reach the Fire Temple, strike five padlocked gongs using Yunobo's rolling charge attack, and defeat Marbled Gohma to awaken the Sage of Fire.

SageOfGerudo.start_zh: 前往北格鲁德遗迹后，找到了正在训练的露珠。协助她进行雷击的练习吧。
SageOfGerudo.start_en: Speak to Riju at the North Gerudo Ruins or enter the Gerudo Town underground shelter.
SageOfGerudo.note_en: Assist Riju with her lightning archery practice, then defend Kara Kara Bazaar and Gerudo Town against waves of Gibdo assaults. Align the light beams between the three desert pillars according to the mural riddle to raise the Lightning Temple. Charge four battery terminals with Riju's lightning and defeat Queen Gibdo to awaken the Sage of Lightning.

SageOfSoul.start_zh: 在龙头岛发现了放出一道光的神秘遗物，光看起来像是笔直地延伸至地面上。“请将它带往
SageOfSoul.start_en: Open the 10-heart door inside the Dragonhead Island sanctuary in the thunderstorm skies above Faron and interact with the glowing Zonai mask.
SageOfSoul.note_en: Attach the relic mask to a flying wing device and follow its projected green light beam down into the Depths to the Construct Factory. Assemble Mineru's construct chassis by retrieving all four limbs (Left Arm, Right Arm, Left Leg, Right Leg) from the surrounding storage depots. Equip weapons to the construct, ride it to the Spirit Temple, and defeat the Seized Construct in a boxing ring showdown to awaken the Sage of Spirit.

SageOfWind.start_zh: 哈茨也不知道关于塞尔达公主的线索。异变发生以来，丘栗进行调查的范围最广，因此哈茨建议去找丘栗打听情况。丘栗似乎和基藏、索里莱丝一起前往了
SageOfWind.start_en: Speak to Tulin and his parents at Rito Village, then meet Tulin at the Hebra Trailhead Lodge or Talonto Peak.
SageOfWind.note_en: Help Tulin recover his bow from an Aerocuda near the lone cedar tree on Talonto Peak. Scale the floating sky island chain above Hebra Peak using Tulin's horizontal wind gust and bouncing off the sails of flying trampoline ships. Board the Wind Temple (the Stormwind Ark), unseal five engine turbines with wind power, and defeat the aerial boss Colgera to awaken the Sage of Wind.

SageOfZora.start_zh: 天地异变之后，淤泥从天而降。卓拉领地内受其污染影响的受害者层出不穷。从卓拉王子的未婚妻优娜口中得知了详情，她希望你前往雷兽山山顶的米法公园，与
SageOfZora.start_en: Speak to Prince Sidon at Mipha Court atop Ploymus Mountain.
SageOfZora.note_en: Solve the sky riddle with Jiahto and King Dorephan in 'The Broken Slate' and 'Clues to the Sky'. Shoot a King's Scale through the floating island teardrop to open the reservoir whirlpool. Cleanse the Ancient Zora Waterworks, ascend the waterfall bridge to the Water Temple in the sky, activate four water wheels using Sidon's water shield ability, and defeat Mucktorok to awaken the Sage of Water.

SurveyOfFourVillages.start_zh: 作为搜寻塞尔达公主的下一步，普尔亚提议对各地发生的异变进行调查。异变集中的地区还有2个。
SurveyOfFourVillages.start_en: Speak to Purah at Lookout Landing after launching from the Lookout Landing Skyview Tower.
SurveyOfFourVillages.note_en: Investigate the extreme weather anomalies threatening four regions across Hyrule: Rito Village (Hebra blizzard - Wind Temple), Goron City (Eldin marble frenzy - Fire Temple), Zora's Domain (Lanayru sludge downpour - Water Temple), and Gerudo Town (Gerudo sand shroud - Lightning Temple). Complete the main questlines in all four settlements to unlock the four ancestral temples and awaken their Sages.

WaterBridgePlace.start_zh: “立足于空鱼之地，放眼望身后身前。浮半空层叠群岩，水滴形历历可辨。王之证射穿水滴，水架桥方位自现。天民同我等卓拉，藉此桥遥遥相连。”基奥托表示，或许应该向
WaterBridgePlace.start_en: Received automatically from Jiahto at Toto Lake after completing The Broken Slate.
WaterBridgePlace.note_en: Sneak behind the throne room in Zora's Domain to overhear the children talking about King Dorephan's hiding place. Find King Dorephan in the Pristine Sanctum behind the waterfall at Mikau Lake to receive King's Scales. Travel to Floating Scales Island (the fish-shaped sky island above Mipha Court), look southwest to line up the floating rocks into a teardrop shape, and shoot an arrow fused with a King's Scale through the center of the teardrop to trigger a pillar of light in the reservoir.
